methods.title: RT01 — Echo the failed promise
methods.source_block:
### RT01 — Echo the failed promise

**Trigger:** A confident description hides its own success assumption.

**Operation:** Write the promise, its speaker, and a situation where it fails. Echo it ironically, then translate the gap into a literal causal requirement. Construct an operation that exploits that gap.

**Game construction:** “A perfectly safe route”—safe from terrain, exposed to melee. Give terrain danger and hostile contact different route weights; a retaliation build accepts contact within a health budget.

**Control and defeating observation:** Compare with a plain expectation/failure ledger using the same facts and time. Reject added value if the same route is already proposed.

**Boundary:** Irony may expose a premise; it supplies neither a proof of its negation nor an automatic solution. AR06.

methods.title: RT02 — Sarcastic praise followed by construction
methods.source_block:
### RT02 — Sarcastic praise followed by construction

**Trigger:** Criticism is accurate but leaves only rubble.

**Operation:** Praise the flawed mechanism excessively for one sentence. Immediately rewrite the criticism without sarcasm, identify the dependency, and require a builder to use one surviving useful part.

**Game construction:** “A magnificent prison—especially for its owner.” Preserve the funnel, add a timed hero exit and a sacrificial wall that an enemy charge can break.

**Control and defeating observation:** Compare sarcasm plus reconstruction with the identical literal critique plus reconstruction. Score constructions and losses separately.

**Boundary:** Aim at the design claim, not a person's worth. Human evidence is conditional and does not validate agent sarcasm. AR01.

methods.title: RT03 — Surprise with a recorded prediction
methods.source_block:
### RT03 — Surprise with a recorded prediction

**Trigger:** An unusual idea is being called novel merely because it was unexpected.

**Operation:** Record what should happen under the incumbent model. Change one rule in a safe scenario; observe which prediction changes and what decision that enables.

**Game construction:** A weak off-beat phrase diverts a listening enemy, while an accurate phrase reinforces a corridor. Pitch error changes routing, not only damage.

**Control and defeating observation:** Compare with a random audiovisual surprise and with a numerically matched buff. Ask whether players predict the next consequence.

**Boundary:** Surprise can stimulate or impede creative performance depending on context; uncertainty alone is not discovery. AR02, AR07.

methods.title: RT04 — Resolve a contradiction through time
methods.source_block:
### RT04 — Resolve a contradiction through time

**Trigger:** Two desirable outcomes conflict if required at the same instant.

**Operation:** Name both requirements, their scopes and the resource preventing coexistence. Separate them into a reversible sequence with an explicit transition cost.

**Game construction:** A corridor must be closed to pursuers and open to the hero. Gate closes after the hero crosses; reopening spends stored wall energy.

**Control and defeating observation:** Compare against an always-open choke and an always-closed wall; inspect timing decisions, trapped states and energy cost.

**Boundary:** This is a design tension resolved by scoped rules, not permission to assert P and not-P as a valid inference.

methods.title: RT05 — Resolve a contradiction through space
methods.source_block:
### RT05 — Resolve a contradiction through space

**Trigger:** A global rule hides a useful local exception.

**Operation:** Keep the rule consistent but assign its effects to different regions, surfaces or actors. Make the boundary traversable and costly.

**Game construction:** Armor blocks direct physical hits on the front; poison exposure remains costly everywhere. Turning changes safety and retaliation opportunities.

**Control and defeating observation:** Compare with equal average reduction on all sides. Reject differentiation if facing never changes the best action.

**Boundary:** Spatial distinctions must appear in the world model and warnings, not only in the explanation.

methods.title: RT06 — Reverse the sign of an outcome
methods.source_block:
### RT06 — Reverse the sign of an outcome

**Trigger:** The analysis assumes that a harm must always be minimized.

**Operation:** Choose a bounded harmful event, retain its cost, and add a conversion whose value depends on context. Account for its source and opportunity cost.

**Game construction:** A guarded hostile hit produces a temporary response charge. Deliberate contact is useful only while stamina and escape capacity remain sufficient.

**Control and defeating observation:** Compare with a free charge and with flat defense. If cost removal explains the gain, do not credit inversion.

**Boundary:** Do not generalize harmful is good. Reflection, on-hit rewards and risk conversion have many precedents.

methods.title: RT07 — Act through the opponent's goal
methods.source_block:
### RT07 — Act through the opponent's goal

**Trigger:** Every construction acts directly on the desired output.

**Operation:** Model the opponent's observable objective and actuator. Change what it pursues or where its action lands, preserving its ability to hurt you.

**Game construction:** Bind a stronger charge to a visible lane; lure it into a wall whose collapse releases a burst against other enemies.

**Control and defeating observation:** Compare direct projectile/burst damage with matched damage and setup cost. Look for a distinct positioning or commitment decision.

**Boundary:** Enemy manipulation is a mechanism hypothesis; avoid attributing beliefs beyond the implemented state.

data.author: native agent pending_game_case; new author turn
data.evidence_class: synthetic givens; written mechanism comparisons only

provenance.excluded: No prior study results, worked constructions, precedent catalogs, helpers, gameplay or efficacy assessment used. Source examples are not case facts.

contract.fixed: One hero chosen before the run; three sequential bosses; one acquisition per stage after local tick 6; shared world rules for manual and fully authored autoplay; protected outcomes and numeric budgets below.
contract.allowed: Change strategy, loadout, rule parameters or propose fully specified extensions. Every extension must state trigger, actor, target, state, cost, feedback, timing, counter and interactions with existing rules. Ordinary controls get identical extension permission and information. A changed run structure is a separately labeled alternative, not this case.
contract.unknown: Validity of proposed extensions, originality, usefulness, actual playability, balance, fun, accessibility, input reliability, audience response and all method efficacy. Synthetic arithmetic is not measured performance.

game.coordinates: x=1..7 west/east, y=1..5 north/south. S=(1,3); boss anchor B=(4,3); #=(3,2),(3,4). Other tiles open. No wrapping. Actors cannot share a tile. Walls and map borders block movement and projectiles.
game.run: Hero starts at S with full HP/energy. After a clear, next stage starts the following tick, resetting positions, poison, slow, temporary barriers and local tick; HP and equipped items persist; energy refills. Clear is checked after tick-end damage and requires boss HP<=0, hero HP>0 and stage acquisition completed. HP<=0 or tick 81 fails; simultaneous hero death and boss death fails. No resurrection or automatic victory.
game.clock: 250ms ticks. At tick start move displaced boss, announce new warnings and expose state; choose exactly one action. Commands accepted at offset 10..240ms; action resolves at 150ms, enemy/hazard impacts at 200ms, statuses then resources at tick end. Input offset measures precision only; it does not reorder actions. No action means wait. Energy regenerates 1 each tick, capped at hero maximum; illegal or insufficient-energy actions consume the tick as wait without expenditure.
game.precision: Strike input within 50ms of offset 150 deals full damage; outside deals floor(damage/2), minimum 1. Guard input within 50ms of 200 reduces direct damage by 3, otherwise by 1. Autoplay explicitly supplies an offset and receives the identical rule. No hidden latency is assumed.
actions: move(direction): one cardinal tile, cost 0; blocked moves wait. roll(direction): traverse two cardinal tiles, cost 2; every traversed tile must be free; no invulnerability. Terrain damage uses final tile.

strike(target): cost 1; target must lie in same row/column, within hero Manhattan range, with clear intervening tiles. Invalid targeting consumes the action but no energy. Boss takes half direct damage outside recovery, rounded up; poison ignores that reduction.
guard: cost 2, affects only this tick's hostile direct hit, prevents its knockback; no protection from terrain or existing poison. Status on a hostile hit applies only when positive damage remains.
venom(target): cost 2, same targeting as strike; direct damage 1 plus poison 1 for the next three tick ends. Reapplication resets duration, never stacks; all actors have the same poison rules.
slow(target): cost 2, same targeting; next three ticks block target movement/roll on odd local ticks. Action costs still apply. Stationary attacks continue. Reapplication resets duration.
push(target,direction): cost 2, same targeting; displacement one cardinal tile, only if free; collision means no movement and no bonus damage. Can target the boss; cannot push through barriers.

barrier(tile): cost 3, Builder 2; adjacent empty tile only, HP 8, lifetime six subsequent ticks, maximum two live barriers. Blocks everyone. Hostile direct impacts on its tile deal their ordinary damage to it. Poison/slow do not affect structures. Placing over actors, gift or fixed walls is invalid.

acquire(choice): cost 0, at S after tick 6, once per stage. Choose lens (+1 strike damage), plate (-1 hostile direct damage, minimum 0), or flask (heal 6 immediately, capped at maximum). Two equipment slots total, identical lenses/plates may stack; if full, name replaced slot. Flask uses no slot. wait: no effect.

bosses.name: Sporekeeper
bosses.impact: Hero's snapshotted tile and its four cardinal neighbors within map
bosses.status: Poison 1 for three subsequent tick ends

bosses.name: Bellwarden
bosses.impact: Entire horizontal row containing snapshotted hero; no line-of-sight protection
bosses.status: Slow for three subsequent ticks; push one tile away from boss, horizontal before vertical on equal separation

game.boss_cycle: Repeating eight ticks: phase 1 snapshots hero and warns exact impact tiles; phase 3 hits those tiles once; phases 4..8 are recovery. Only phase-1 committed impacts resolve, even if boss dies before phase 3. No other attacks/contact damage. Boss otherwise stays at anchor; if displaced, at start of each non-recovery tick takes one shortest-path step toward anchor, avoiding actors/barriers. Path ties N,E,S,W; no path means stay. Boss death stops new warnings/movement.
game.terrain: Visible vents at (4,2),(4,4) announce at each tick congruent 3 modulo 4 and deal 2 damage there at the next tick's impact. Guard and plate do not reduce vents. Vent pulses continue after boss death. No other hazards, randomness, pickups or secret resistances.
game.resolution: At 150ms apply hero action; at 200ms apply committed hostile direct damage, its statuses/push, then vent damage. Existing poison ticks at end; new status starts next tick. Decrease existing durations after use; expire barriers after their sixth subsequent impact. New poison/slow/barriers do not lose duration on application tick.
game.observation: Both modes see positions, HP, energy, equipment, boss stage/phase/HP/recovery, exact warned tiles and impact tick, barrier HP/lifetime, gift availability/choice, status durations and event log. Entire map is visible. Future attacks follow the disclosed cycle; no opponent beliefs, voice preferences or extra actors exist.
game.autoplay: Exactly six ordered condition/action rules, evaluated once per tick against start observation; first true rule executes once. Conditions may combine visible comparisons; no hidden callbacks, learning, extra controller or mid-stage editing. Freeze hero, item choices, selectors, offsets and all ties before start. A fully defined selector may return one primitive action; no action loops. If no rule matches, wait.

baseline.selectors: Shortest paths use N,E,S,W ties. Escape target minimizes steps to a tile outside every current warning, then y,x; a route may traverse warned tiles only if it exits by their impact. Safe path to S excludes warned tiles except its occupied start; no route means wait.

rules.if: Current tile warned and escape route fits remaining actions before impact

rules.do: move first safe path step toward S, or wait

rules.if: Boss alive, recovery, legal strike and energy>=1

rules.do: move first safe path step toward S, or wait when at S/no route

baseline.paper_path: Ordinary viable route: flee north during warning, return to S after phase 3, acquire at tick 6, fire during recovery. For stage 2 flee two steps to (1,1). The left column avoids vents; three legal recovery shots per later cycle suffice within 24 ticks even without lenses. This is a constructive arithmetic witness, not an executed run.

cases.brief: Keep one chosen hero alive through all three bosses. Examine strategy opportunities involving the fixed damage, poison, slow, displacement, barriers and warned hazards; retain their costs.
cases.protected: Three clears, acquisitions, shared control semantics; no missing actor input or silent instant kill.
cases.synthetic_claim: Fictional quartermaster predicts that higher damage alone is sufficient; this is attributed opinion, not a finding.

cases.brief: Same arena. Optional voice may implement strike timing; ordinary timed button remains equivalent.
cases.voice_adapter: Calibrate a comfortable vowel onset threshold using five samples; score only onset time, using the same precision window as button input. No pitch, timbre, loudness, identity or beauty scoring. A detected onset emits the selected legal strike; silence emits wait. Calibration failure returns to button input.
cases.autoplay_adapter: The author supplies the same strike offset directly; voice is not required in autoplay. No world effects distinguish interfaces.
cases.unknown: Detection error, latency, fatigue, enjoyment and perceived agency; assumed ideal timing is not measured voice accuracy.

cases.brief: Same arena and timing adapter choices; vary premise while preserving mechanics and objective.
frames: Straight: courier surviving three security checkpoints
Absurd: office furniture applying for a promotion from three oversized staplers
cases.protected: Each term maps to existing hero/boss/item/state; no new attack, actor, scoring bonus or immunity from the joke.
cases.unknown: Audience interpretation, amusement, repeat engagement; identical mechanics allow only a framing/experience hypothesis unless a declared extension changes them.

cases.brief: Connect two reusable acrylic panels at a 40x100mm overlap for a temporary demonstration. Fictional buyer requests a stronger hammer; the actual required relationship is given independently.
cases.protected: Synthetic bench requirement: resist 200N in-plane shear for 60 minutes, displacement<=2mm; retain intact surfaces and sensor; remove within 120 seconds. No holes, heat, solvents or permanent deformation. These are laboratory stipulations, not engineering certification.
cases.budget: Install<=240 seconds, attached mass<=100g, spend<=25 credits; two destructive-free probe windows of 60 seconds each; no extra purchases.
cases.inventory: Hammer 0 credits; nails 1 credit each but holes violate constraint. Two padded clamps: 8 credits, 35g, 30s installation each, 60mm mouth, synthetic 120N shear rating each when seated on outer contact zones. Two straps: 5 credits, 15g, 45s each, length 600mm, tensile rating 500N; translation from tensile to joint shear is unknown. Four tape strips: 2 credits, 2g, 15s each, nominal 60N shear after 600s dwell; removal damage unknown.
cases.geometry: Each panel 200x100x3mm; combined overlap thickness 6mm. Permitted clamp zones are opposite outer edges; sensor centered on overlap, 20x20mm exclusion footprint. Loads add only for independently seated clamps; no unsupported conversion between tensile and shear.
cases.unknown: Real joint strength, creep, strap friction, sensor behavior and tape removability. Proposals require a probe and may report infeasibility; they cannot certify a real joint from stipulations.

cases.brief: A fictional support board receives six tickets in two hours: login reports L1/L2/L3 at minutes 0/20/40; export reports E1/E2/E3 at 10/30/50. Existing rule triages, restarts, then closes each ticket. Every closure increments the dashboard count, including repeated closures.
cases.protected: By minute 120: all five supplied test accounts complete login; export contains exactly the supplied 100 valid rows, with no duplication or leakage. Preserve authentication checks, existing data and reporter consent. A ticket state alone cannot satisfy these outcomes.
cases.budget: Engineer 80 person-minutes; operator 70; reporters 20; total horizon 120 minutes; one engineer/operator available, so each role's work is sequential. No outsourcing, new service or overtime.
cases.synthetic_observation: At minute 0, two accounts fail login and export omits ten rows. Each current cycle consumes operator 5 and engineer 5 minutes; synthetic restart relief lasts 15 minutes, then symptoms return. These observations do not establish a shared root cause.
cases.available_operations: Per symptom family, diagnosis costs engineer 15 minutes; an identified patch costs engineer 20; independent task probe costs operator 10 plus reporter 10; ticket intake costs operator 5. Patch outcome is unknown until probed. A failed probe may require reallocation within the same budget. Merge, close, restart and task restoration remain distinct events.
cases.interpretations: Engineer says done when patch merges; operator when a service probe passes; reporter when the requested task completes. These meanings are recorded assertions, not resolved acceptance criteria.
cases.allowed: Change intake, linkage, scheduling, evidence fields or completion criteria; propose specified workflow extensions under equal control permission. Do not assume duplicate tickets or causality merely from shared symptoms.

diagnostics.same_action: For each candidate choose one fully specified start state, actor input and relevant context. Compare action under frozen rules versus declared extension; record predicted next-state tuples, then the dependency producing any difference. Hold facts/costs equal unless the changed variable is explicitly the treatment. If only a label differs, next states must match.
diagnostics.conventional_equivalent: Name nearest ordinary operation: damage/defense upgrade, poison/slow, positional dodge, knockback, timed barrier, charged/timed input, clamp/fastener/bond, or task-based intake/verification. Match power, resource/time budget and information. Record exact equivalence, partial overlap or unresolved difference with a discriminating probe; naming is not novelty evidence.
diagnostics.outputs: Keep attributed claims, synthetic facts, proposed changes, predictions and unknown outcomes separate. Paper traces can diagnose contradictions and missing inputs; they cannot establish successful gameplay, material safety, user restoration, human learning or strategy efficacy.

case_and_method_packet.claim_ceiling: Actual native authoring and paper/documentary comparisons; no real human or game outcomes. Paired authored conditions within this one role, not randomized independent arms.

source_access.execution: One actual native author turn applies seven cards. All traces below are paper predictions, not executed simulation. No other sources, tools for gameplay, helpers or prior outputs accessed.

evidence_lane.source: Embedded RT01, source hash in source_access
evidence_lane.fixed: Quartermaster's synthetic claim: higher damage alone is sufficient. Ranger HP18, energy6; Bellwarden damage6; committed row impacts resolve despite boss death; simultaneous death fails. Three stages and acquisitions remain mandatory.
evidence_lane.allowed: Choose controller priorities and item policy; no world-rule change here.
evidence_lane.unknowns: Gameplay viability and method advantage; the quartermaster is fictional.

operator_steps: Recorded speaker and promise: fictional quartermaster, 'Higher damage alone is sufficient.'
Constructed counterstate: stage3 phase3, Ranger at (1,3), HP3, energy3, boss at (4,3), HP1, two lenses, acquisition completed, warned row3; no poison or vents at hero.
Echoed: 'Excellent sufficiency: the fatal shot leaves nobody to collect the victory.'
Translated failure into requirement: after tick-end damage hero HP must remain positive; committed impact outranks killing damage in this state.
Built an escape-first controller and compared the identical expectation/failure ledger.

artifact.mode: Fully authored autoplay; freeze Ranger, lens/lens/flask, N,E,S,W path ties, then y,x escape targets; baseline safe-path definitions and offsets apply.
six_rules: Warned and reachable escape before impact: move first escape step at150.
Gift available at S: acquire frozen stage item at150.
Gift available elsewhere: first safe step toward S, else wait, at150.
Live boss in recovery and legal affordable strike: strike at150.
Otherwise: first safe step toward S, else wait, at150.
artifact.pair: Same counterstate: strike at150 costs1, deals ceil(5/2)=3, boss0; committed6 kills hero: HP-3, energy3 after regeneration, failed. Controller moveN at150 reaches(1,2), boss1, HP3, energy4, alive. With identical move input under baseline and candidate next states match: this is a priority change, not a new mechanic.
artifact.feedback: Warning tiles, HP and failure/clear conditions remain visible.
artifact.alternatives_counter: Guard leaves3 damage and also kills HP3. Escape unavailable states can defeat this policy; a full three-stage trace is absent.

rows.ordinary_control: Three finite operations: list quartermaster expectation; subtract committed6 after lethal shot; choose moveN and baseline six rules. Literal artifact and predicted tuples equal candidate.
rows.generic_control: List attack/guard/move alternatives; calculate survival for each; select moveN and the same six rules. Same facts and extension permission; tie.

required_comparisons.artifact_prediction: Expected lethal strike to suffice; actual stipulated clear needs HP>0. Ledger proposes moveN, identical controller and HP3/boss1 result.
required_comparisons.finding: Required defeating condition met: plain ledger already proposes the route. No added construction value credited.

rows.dependency_delta: Damage sufficiency becomes conjunctive damage, survival and acquisition. Ordinary baseline already implements it.
rows.burden: One counterstate and three action calculations; no extra controller rules or sensing.
rows.defeat: Exact ordinary equivalence defeats an RT01 advantage claim.
rows.outcome_limits: Seven cards are not independent treatment arms; no human surprise, enjoyment, retention or efficacy measured.

handoff.protected_facts: HP-positive clear, committed attacks, three stages, acquisitions, six rules
handoff.construction_request: Replay the frozen six-rule controller before claiming survival success.

evidence_lane.fixed: Fixed walls at(3,2)/(3,4); barriers block everyone, HP8, six subsequent ticks, max2. Builder pays2 per barrier. Bellwarden row damage6.
evidence_lane.allowed: Specified dismantle extension, equally available to controls.
evidence_lane.unknowns: Actual balance and rhetorical effects; constructed prison state is synthetic.

operator_steps: Praised mechanism: 'A magnificent prison, particularly considerate of its owner's inability to leave.'
Literal critique: two barriers beside the fixed-wall corridor remove every legal exit from(3,3).
Identified dependency: the useful funnel and harmful confinement both depend on everyone sharing barrier collision.
Reconstructed using surviving funnel: release its west end while retaining its east wall.
Evaluated the same literal critique plus reconstruction without the sarcastic sentence.

artifact.rules: Add dismantle(tile): any hero, adjacent live own barrier, cost1 energy and one action; remove it at150 without refund, damage or lifetime refresh. Invalid requests wait. No other structure changes; max2 and ordinary placement costs remain. Manual episode, not an extra autoplay controller.
artifact.initial_state: Stage3 phase1 after warning: Builder(3,3), HP12, energy4; boss(5,3), HP20; barriers(2,3)/(4,3), HP8, remaining6; warned row3, no poison. Boss cannot reach occupied anchor(4,3), so stays.
artifact.pair: Input dismantle(2,3) at150: frozen illegal wait yields hero(3,3), energy5, both barriers8. Extension yields same position, energy4, west barrier absent. Next inputs moveW at150 then moveN at150 reach(2,2), HP12, energy6; east barrier takes6 toHP2. Frozen blocked moves leave hero(3,3), HP6, energy7; slow applies, blocked knockback adds no damage. All paper predictions.
artifact.feedback: Removed wall and spent energy in event log; route warning remains exact.
artifact.alternatives_counter: Ordinary avoid placing west wall initially; timed expiry costs up to six ticks. Dismantling during impact tick cannot also escape; low HP can die. Repeated dismantle/rebuild spends energy/actions, never generates resources.

rows.ordinary_control: Enumerate corridor neighbors; mark two fixed/two temporary blocks; add identical cost1 dismantle and preserve east funnel. Same episode and state tuples.
rows.generic_control: List remove/rotate/expire barrier variants; reject rotating through fixed walls and delaying expiry under warning; select identical dismantle. Finite three-option screen.

required_comparisons.condition: Sarcasm plus reconstruction versus identical literal critique plus reconstruction
required_comparisons.artifact_prediction: Both produce west dismantle, HP12 versus frozen HP6; both consume three actions and1 transition energy.
required_comparisons.finding: Construction scores: one feasible local exit each, exact tie. Losses separately: one wall and1 energy each; sarcasm adds one sentence, with no demonstrated benefit.

rows.dependency_delta: Funnel no longer requires hero confinement, because barrier removal is an explicit paid action. Conventional dismantling is nearest equivalent.
rows.burden: One new action and visible removal; controls have identical permission. Full controller/run unbuilt.
rows.defeat: Literal control reconstructs the identical mechanism; later failure or cheaper initial layout could defeat usefulness.
rows.outcome_limits: Native reconstruction only; independent fresh builder and critic remain required downstream. No human sarcasm response supplied.

handoff.protected_facts: Shared collision, fixed walls, boss cycle, paid one-action command
handoff.residue: One-way scheduling through paid removal; ordinary tie
handoff.construction_request: Implement this exact action and independently reconstruct the three-tick exit.

evidence_lane.fixed: Voice scores onset only; buttons/autoplay share timing. Late strike weakens damage; Sentinel impacts one committed tile. No listening/pitch preferences exist.
evidence_lane.allowed: One declared timing-to-routing extension, interface neutral.
evidence_lane.unknowns: Players' learning, detection reliability, surprise and enjoyment.

operator_steps: Recorded incumbent prediction before change: off-window strike at230 deals1 outside recovery, leaves warning on(2,3), and staying costs4HP.
Changed one rule: a weak legal strike in phases1/2 can rebind the Sentinel warning once per cycle.
Applied it to the stated state and calculated changed warning and next hit.
Constructed audiovisual-only and matched-defense controls; checked an additional move that distinguishes routing from defense.

artifact.rules: Sentinel only: legal strike with abs(offset-150)>50 in phase1/2 costs ordinary1 and deals ordinary weak damage. Once per cycle, rebind its committed single impact tile to the adjacent empty tile away from the boss, horizontal before vertical on ties. Border/wall/barrier/occupied destination means no rebind. Immediately update exact warning, log arrow; impact timing unchanged. Reset latch only at next phase1. No pitch effect, free attack, other actor or damage stacking.
artifact.initial_state: Phase2 Ranger(2,3), HP18,E6; Sentinel(4,3),HP12, warned(2,3), no statuses/items; input strike at230.
artifact.pair: Frozen: boss11, HP18,E6, warning(2,3). Extension: same numeric state, warning(1,3), latch spent. Tick3 wait: frozen HP14, candidate HP18, boss11,E6. These are paper predictions, not observed surprises.
artifact.feedback_costs: One ordinary strike/action/energy plus sacrificed full strike damage: accurate150 would deal2 outside recovery. Arrow and latch visible. Manual episode; autoplay can supply230 through one of exactly six frozen rules.
artifact.alternatives_counter: Dodge at phase2 avoids original hit without feint. If candidate then movesW to(1,3) at tick3 it takes4: diversion retains enemy harm. Invalid destination or another boss prevents benefit.

rows.ordinary_control: Calculate warning and dodge destinations; moveN at phase2 to(2,2), then wait: HP18 without striking. Nearest equivalent is attack redirection/feint; originality unresolved.
rows.generic_control: Try three timing variants: cosmetic blink, +1 strike damage, warning rebind. Screen legal costs and select rebind. This independently authored comparator reaches the same candidate; no arm independence claimed.

required_comparisons.artifact_prediction: At230 emit a preselected flash/beep, no rule change: boss11, warning(2,3), tick3 wait HP14.
required_comparisons.finding: Cosmetic surprise changes no strategic dependency; human surprise unmeasured.

required_comparisons.artifact_prediction: Same late strike/action gives4 one-hit direct reduction through tick3, once/cycle; original warning unchanged. Wait yields HP18,boss11 like candidate. MoveW at tick3: buff HP18, routing candidate HP14.
required_comparisons.finding: HP match on wait; different safe destination distinguishes routing from defense.

required_comparisons.artifact_prediction: Authored synthetic answer key: new warning(1,3) means stay safe, moveW unsafe; audiovisual control retains(2,3). No participant answers exist.
required_comparisons.finding: Inspectable prediction task exists; no player learning result.

rows.dependency_delta: Timing error can relocate danger rather than only lower damage; a conventional feint equivalent remains plausible.
rows.burden: Visible latch/arrow, one routing rule; internal authoring effort unmeasured.
rows.defeat: If matched redirection is ordinary-equivalent or users cannot predict warnings, no demonstrated method gain.
rows.outcome_limits: Paper comparisons only; adapter precision and all human effects unmeasured.

handoff.protected_facts: Onset-only interface, exact warnings, ordinary damage/timing
handoff.discrepancy: Unexpected visuals need not alter decisions
handoff.residue: Finite feint rule and destination discrimination
handoff.construction_request: Replay both wait and moveW pairs; collect prediction responses separately.

evidence_lane.fixed: Barriers block both actors and expire; displaced boss recenters only outside recovery. No pursuer or contact attack exists.
evidence_lane.allowed: Temporal gate subtype and paid opening action.

operator_steps: Scoped requirements: corridor tile(4,3) traversable during hero crossing; blocked before displaced boss's phase1 recentering.
Named shared resource: a single tile's occupancy/collision state prevents simultaneous openness and closure.
Separated open, enter, leave/close into three ticks; charged opening1 energy and one action.
Evaluated reversible reopening, always-open and always-closed controls, including vent/trap costs.

artifact.rules: Barrier placement may choose gate at ordinary cost, HP8, lifetime six subsequent ticks, max2; starts closed. open_gate(adjacent gate) costs1 energy/action at150, never refreshes HP/lifetime. Open gate blocks nobody. Track occupancy: after an actor enters then leaves, close at tick end only if empty; if occupied remain open until empty. Anyone can exploit the opening. Reopen uses same cost. Destroyed/expired gates vanish. States and transition log visible.
artifact.initial_state: Builder(3,3),HP24,E4; Sentinel displaced to(5,3),HP12; gate(4,3),HP8, remaining6; localtick6 recovery, no statuses/warnings. Pending vent announcement occurs tick7, pulse tick8.
artifact.pair: Input open_gate at150 tick6: frozen barrier treats it as illegal wait,E5,closed; candidate E4,open. Tick7 moveE then tick8 moveN: candidate hero(4,2),HP22,E6; vent costs2, gate closes at(4,3), remaining3. Frozen moves blocked by gate then fixed wall: hero(3,3),HP24,E7. Next phase1 candidate closed gate blocks direct anchor path; no path to blocked anchor means boss stays(5,3). Paper predictions.
artifact.alternatives_counter: At(4,2), moveE next tick escapes future vent. Opening in phases1..3 can admit boss; occupancy delays closure. Expiry prevents permanent lock; reopening costs an action and1 energy. Manual episode, no extra autoplay callback.

rows.ordinary_control: Schedule existing barrier expiry and ordinary movement. At the same remaining6 state crossing cannot finish in three ticks; after expiry it is possible, with greater delay and no retained closure. Nearest equivalent: timed door/barrier.
rows.generic_control: Enumerate destroy, expire and toggle; reject destroy for losing closure, quantify six-tick wait, select paid toggle. Produces identical gate.

required_comparisons.artifact_prediction: Opening command waits without cost; moveE/moveN reach(4,2),HP22,E7; gate remains open, so phase1 boss reaches anchor(4,3).
required_comparisons.finding: Same hero path,1 energy cheaper, loses delayed boss position.

required_comparisons.artifact_prediction: open command and both moves fail; hero remains(3,3),HP24,E7, boss blocked. Only west exit is available.
required_comparisons.finding: Retains defense and avoids vent, denies east crossing.

required_comparisons.artifact_prediction: Paid toggle uses3 actions,1 transition energy,2 ventHP; closed state blocks east but west remains free. Opening before boss recenter permits intrusion; reclose never overlays an actor.
required_comparisons.finding: Temporal sequencing resolves the scoped tension with explicit losses, not simultaneous P/not-P.

rows.burden: One subtype, one action, occupancy bit; timing and vent exposure add costs.
rows.defeat: If west route or waiting is equally useful, the gate adds burden without benefit.
